THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: 5/3/4/1- (1891). Ministry of Land and Parliamentary Reforms Reference No: 4-3/7/2017/HW/308. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/Servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or Servitude to be Acquired:

The allotments of Land, containing in extent of 1.3712 Hectare, Lots 1- 14(14 lots) under mentioned land shown in the Surveyor General’s Preliminary Plan No. Ma-1787 dated on 24.07.2019, situated in the village of Welamitiyawa,

Dambulla in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of Welamitiyawa (E440 D), in Dambulla Divisional Secretary’s Division in Matale District of Central Province. 1.
